title: Holographic entanglement entropy, Wilson loops, and neural networks
summary: We apply artificial neural networks to the holographic inverse problem, reconstructing bulk geometry from boundary entanglement entropy by using the Ryu--Takayanagi area functional as a differentiable loss. Validated on the AdS-Schwarzschild background, this approach recovers the blackening factor with maximum absolute error below $3\times10^{-3}$ across the entire bulk, reproducibly over independent training runs.
